title: Giant Four
summary: A turn-based board game: four in a row on a giant board on the town square. Players take turns; bots take the empty seats.

verified.result: PASS 22/22 with --quick (9 skipped by --quick). Check 7, the audio gate, passes on the kits' qa-gate-v5 (it failed by half a decibel on gate v4)
verified.how: npx gamesfun create <dir> --from giant-four, npx gamesfun verify <dir> --quick (120 s), by the smoke test (Linux, Chrome on the graphics card)
